messages:
Ravi M: Hi team - joined last week (3/9). My benefits still show Pending and I have a gap risk: old plan ended 3/15 but our portal says effective 4/1. Can we get coverage sooner? Also I bought a storage unit while relocating, receipt attached. Is that reimbursable?

Benefits Bot: Auto-responder: standard_new_hire_effective = first of month after start. Exceptions require proof of prior coverage end. See https://benefits.redwood.com/new-hires.

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Ravi! We can request a retroactive effective date to cover the gap if you provide proof of loss of coverage (COBRA/termination letter) showing end date 2026-03-15. Please email benefits@redwood.com and put "Retroactive Coverage Request - Ravi M" in subject.

Ravi M: Uploaded COBRA termination email to benefits@redwood.com just now. Will that do? Also the storage unit was $210/mo for 2 months while movers delayed. Policy mentions 'reasonable moving costs' but not storage explicitly.

Maya (People Ops): COBRA email should be fine; benefits team will confirm. Regarding storage: short-term storage fees due to moving delays are sometimes approved if pre-approved by People Ops or included in the signed relocation allowance. Since yours wasn't pre-approved, send receipts + short explanation and we'll route to Finance for manual review.

Juan (Payroll): Quick payroll note: if we approve a retroactive effective date we make a benefits cost adjustment; it may reflect on the next payroll cycle after approval. Storage reimbursements processed via Expensify under category "Relocation" or emailed to benefits@redwood.com if you don't have that category. Attach manager approval.

Ravi M: I don't see Relocation in Expensify. Who's my manager approval—Lena?

Lena (Hiring Manager): Yep I approve. I had to delay the official move due to start date changes; I approve Ravi's storage costs for 2 months. Lena K endorses.

Ravi M: Thanks Lena! Emailing benefits now with receipts and Lena cc'd. Any estimate on timing for coverage change?

Maya (People Ops): Benefits team aims to respond within 2 business days; once approved payroll updates usually within one pay cycle. If you need documentation sooner for providers, ask benefits for a dated confirmation letter and we'll expedite.

Benefits Bot: Ticket created: BEN-2026-0511 (retro coverage request). Expect update by 2026-03-18.

Ravi M: Appreciate it. One tiny follow-up: are moving-related small purchases (tape, mattress covers) automatically denied without mover invoice? I have a $24 packing supplies receipt.

Maya (People Ops): Small items under $50 are usually approved if justified and included with other mover invoices. Include them in your email bundle; we'll bundle approvals where possible.

Ravi M: Sent everything. Thanks all :smile:

Benefits Bot: Confirmed receipt. BEN-2026-0511 updated. We'll post final decision here.

Juan (Payroll): FYI: If storage is approved as relocation, it's tax-free up to policy limits; otherwise treated as taxable reimbursement. If you want gross-up, state that in email and include manager sign-off.

Ravi M: Noted. I'll mark gross-up preference if needed. Thanks everyone!
